about.heading: Good editing is more than cutting clips.
about.subheading: It's rhythm, psychological tension, and respect for the viewer's clock.
bio: I am Jashandeep Singh, a video editor and post-production specialist dedicated to shaping footage into memorable cinematic experiences.

Over the past 7+ years, I've partnered with international directors, agencies, healthcare networks, and top-tier creator brands. My philosophy is rooted in intentional pacing: every frame must earn its place on the timeline.

Operating from a calibrated dual-monitor studio with hardware control surfaces, I handle the complete post pipeline from initial assembly and paper cut through to final ACES color grading and sound master conform.

process.heading: Simple process. Thoughtful execution.
process.description: A transparent, frictionless workflow designed to respect client timelines and creative integrity at every milestone.

steps.title: DISCOVER
steps.description: Deep dive into project briefs, audience objectives, references, brand guidelines, and raw asset ingestion.

steps.title: PLAN
steps.description: Establish narrative arcs, select key interview selects, design soundscape foundation, and build paper cut outlines.

steps.title: EDIT
steps.description: Assemble the timeline through surgical pacing, sound effects design, motivated cuts, and rough grade pass.

steps.title: REFINE
steps.description: Frame.io collaborative review. Tightening timing, pacing micro-adjustments, kinetic typography, and audio leveling.

steps.title: DELIVER
steps.description: Master conform export in Apple ProRes 4444/422, H.264 web delivery, social aspect ratios, and full archive project packaging.

testimonials.author: Marcus Vogel
testimonials.quote: Jashandeep possesses an uncanny instinct for rhythm. When we handed him 14 hours of unstructured footage for our brand commercial, he returned an edit that made our executive team pause in silence. Zero fluff, absolute narrative punch.

testimonials.author: Elena Rostova
testimonials.quote: In medical documentary, balance is everything. If the cut is too fast, you lose trust; if it's too slow, you lose audience retention. Jashandeep found the sweet spot on our first version cut. His timeline hygiene and communication are pristine.

testimonials.author: Kai Abernathy
testimonials.quote: Working with Jashandeep boosted our YouTube average view duration from 32% to over 54% within two months. He understands how modern viewers process information without resorting to annoying hype edits.
